$description: The colour roles of the light theme. The pages use them as CSS custom properties of the same name.

bg-raised.$description: The sidebar, inputs and other parts above the page.

bg-panel.$description: The inside of a panel, and the tooltip of a chart.

bg-hover.$description: A row or a link under the pointer, and a neutral badge.

border.$description: Thin lines: panel edges, table rows and chart grid lines.

border-strong.$description: Strong lines: input edges, table heads and chart axes.

text-dim.$description: Text that matters less: labels, and the text of chart axes.

text-faint.$description: Text that matters least, such as hints and time stamps.

accent.$description: Links, focus and the active item.

accent-dim.$description: A quiet accent fill: the active segment and the primary button.
